findings.label: ValidationPipe 400 not documented in OpenAPI for /auth/login
findings.detail: The global ValidationPipe (whitelist/forbidNonWhitelisted on LoginRequestDto) yields a 400 that is not listed among the OpenAPI responses for POST /auth/login. The validation itself is in place; only the doc entry is missing. Cosmetic.

findings.label: Timing side channel on unknown-user branch
findings.detail: When the user is not found, bcrypt.compare never runs, so the unknown-user path returns faster than the wrong-password path (theoretical enumeration via timing). Status and body are identical and the task requirement (uniform generic error path) is met; flagged for awareness only.
